contentText:
It's not a PC port or a remake , but Sony is returning to the Gothic world of Bloodborne . There aren't many details yet - Sony says that "plot details are still being kept under wraps" - but the game is being adapted into "an R-rated animated feature," with YouTuber Seán "Jacksepticeye" McLoughlin ( a known Bloodborne fan ) serving as a producer. No word on when the film might be premiering.
